claim_boundary: Preserved systems-gate distributed-desynchronization evidence only. One full update completed, then update 2 made no progress for more than ten minutes while seven GPUs remained in collective work and rank 6 remained idle. The job was cancelled to avoid wasting eight RTX 4090 GPUs. No checkpoint, development evaluation, production training, or test access occurred.

failure.gpu_observation: GPU indices 0-5 and 7 remained at 100 percent utilization near 77-90 W while GPU index 6 remained at 0 percent utilization near 24 W across three five-second samples.

minimal_correction.scope: Add per-rank phase receipts and reduce the systems-gate process-group timeout from fifteen to three minutes so the next immutable retry identifies and fails closed on the first divergent phase without another long eight-GPU stall.
